PROGRAM NC0025

ROUTINE R()
VAR
  L_1 : INTEGER
BEGIN
  L_1 = 1
  SELECT L_1 OF
  	CASE(1):
  		SELECT L_1 OF
  			CASE(1):
  				SELECT L_1 OF
  					CASE(1):
  						SELECT L_1 OF
  							CASE(1):
  								SELECT L_1 OF
  									CASE(1):
  										L_1 = L_1 + 1
  									CASE(2):
  										L_1 = L_1 + 2
  									ELSE:
  										L_1 = L_1 + 3
  								ENDSELECT
  							CASE(2):
  								L_1 = L_1 + 2
  							ELSE:
  								L_1 = L_1 + 3
  						ENDSELECT
  					CASE(2):
  						L_1 = L_1 + 2
  					ELSE:
  						L_1 = L_1 + 3
  				ENDSELECT
  			CASE(2):
  				L_1 = L_1 + 2
  			ELSE:
  				L_1 = L_1 + 3
  		ENDSELECT
  	CASE(2):
  		L_1 = L_1 + 2
  	ELSE:
  		L_1 = L_1 + 3
  ENDSELECT
  RETURN
END R

ROUTINE NC0025()
BEGIN
  R
  RETURN
END NC0025
